nohd.basis: IEC 60825-1:2014 Table A.1 (MPE = 18 t^0.75 J/m2, visible, t 0.25 s blink / 10 s), NOHD = (sqrt(4P/(pi MPE)) - a)/phi with a = 6 mm (ASSUMED, the safe end for NOHD), phi = 1.3 mrad full angle (EQUIVALENT); the 1/e2 line converts both by 1/sqrt(2). Diffuse: sqrt(rho P / (pi MPE)) (ANSI Z136.1 extended-source simplification, as moxir_v1_1.nohd()). The hall is 108 m long: every beam is hazardous wherever it is; separation (3.0 m / 2.5 m) and the hard stop are the control, not distance or dimming.
